name: How often should I get a roof health assessment?

mainEntity.name: How often should I get a roof health assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: We recommend getting a roof health assessment at least once every 1-3 years, or after any significant weather event like a major storm with hail or strong winds. Regular assessments can catch minor issues before they become costly problems and extend your roof's lifespan. During the assessment, our team also checks for common wear patterns specific to the DFW area, which can include hail damage often requiring prompt attention.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's recommended to get a roof health assessment every 1-3 years, or after severe weather, to catch minor issues and extend your roof's lifespan.
